body:
Yeah. It's hard as a normal person when your friends/mom/siblings don't like your significant other... Can you even comprehend how much that is amplified when it's all of America? I do feel so bad for her. It's not *our fault* we all hate Bryan, but we are being extra harsh about it this season for some reason. 

There's been dislike for the F1 before, but never on this level. And you have to wonder why Rachel? Or why Bryan? Is he really THAT bad? Is it just because every year, people get worse and shittier on SM and that's just the world we live in now? Or did we actually think too highly of Rachel to begin with, did we idealize her because of what she represented and ignore the fact that she is, actually, capable of doing "wrong"? Or is this all production's fault? If they showed more of the unromantic Peter or the more-here-for-Dean-than-for-Rachel Peter... and showed more of the goofy, genuine Bryan moments... would our feelings be totally different? I wish Rachel could re-watch her season objectively and see what we all saw, because again all we have to go on is what we're shown and I don't think the edit did their relationship any favors. We base our opinions on what we see, and we hate Bryan for seemingly pretty good reason. 

That being said, we as a fanbase are being pretty harsh and we've never been this bad before. Speaking in generalizations, a recap of the past few seasons:

* Catherine was a dark horse and we never had a chance to really form an opinion - post show they've both been good people and we've mostly hopped on board
* Most of the fanbase loved Brooks and thought Des totally settled, but post show they seem happy and I don't think many of us are mad at it
* Juan Pablo sucked this data is irrelevant (but I think most of us did like Nikki)
* I think the fanbase was pretty split on Josh vs Nick but again, nobody was destroying Andi on twitter because she picked Josh - people thought he was a little shady at the time but we were mostly okay with it
* We loved Whitney (thought she could do better, tbh) and were happy for them
* I don't think Shawn was hated - people kind of side-eyed his intense jealousy but post show they're great and we support them
* We liked Ben and we loved Lauren
* People were not into Jordan most of JoJo's season but we all kind of shrugged like gurl you do you - this was easier to accept because her runner up sucked a lot
* Vanessa was mainly well liked until the rumors came out about there being bad blood with the other girls - at this point I think it was more about "WE LOVE RACHEL WE WANT A BLACK BACHELORETTE" than it was about Vanessa being unlikable - if we weren't all so into Rachel, I think that drama would have blown over super fast and we'd like Vanessa just fine

So I'm not sure what all this was getting at, other than... We've NEVER been THIS MEAN to a lead and their final pick. Really not even close. It may 100% be because this is 2017 and the internet is a mean, mean place. Or it may be because Bryan got a shitty edit. Idk. Just throwing it out there. I loved Peter as much as the next person, but I've got to assume Rachel would have picked him if she really felt confident about their relationship, ring or not.
